cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem tohoto předmětu je praktické seznámení studentů na magisterském stupni vzdělávání jednak se základy současného stupně poznání v půdní biologii z vědeckého hlediska a jednak praktická znalost základních přístupů k charakteristice biologické aktivity půdy. Součástí tohoto předmětu je též praktická činnost v půdně biologické/půdně biochemické laboratoři na dodaných půdních vzorcích.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course is designed for both getting students familiar with the current level of soil biological knowledge and routine approaches for a site evaluation from the viewpoint of its soil biological activity. Students themselfs will be working with the soil samples in soil biological/soil biochemical laboratory.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Definition of soil biology. (allowance 2/1) a.Soil biology and related disciplines.b.Soil as an environment for organisms, factors affecting occurence of organisms in soil.2.Viruses, cyanobacteria, bacteria and actinomycetes in soil. (allowance 2/1)3.Fungi, algea and protozoa in soil. (allowance 2/1)4.Soil fauna, food webs and interactions between soil organisms (neutralism, protocooperation, competition, comenzalism, amenzalism, parazitism and predation). (allowance 2/1)5.Microorganism and an enviroment. (allowance 2/1) a.Microorganisms of other terrestrial environments.b.Microorganisms on surfaces of plants.c.Rock-inhabiting microorganisms.d.Deep, subsurface communities of microorganisms.e.Microorganisms of extreme environments.f.Termophilic algea, fungi, cyanobacteria and bacteria; microbial communities of extremely acidic, alcaline and highly saline environments.6.Plant root exudates. (allowance 2/1) a.Role of root exudates in plant nutrition.b.Microbiology of the rhizosphere.7.Decomposition of carbonacous compounds in soil (cellulose, hemicelluloses, lignin, etc) - a role of different groups of organisms. (allowance 2/1)8.Role of organisms in transformation of nitrogen-containing compounds, transformation of other elements. (allowance 2/1) a.Ammonification, nitrification, N-fixation, denitrification.b.Biological transformation of phosphorus.c.Biological transformation of sulphur.9.Soil enzymes. (allowance 2/1) a.Soil enzymes location: endoenzymes, exoenzymes, biontic, abiontic; regulation of their synthesis and activity.b.Use of knowledges about soil enzymes.c.Methods for analysis of activities of soil enzymes.10.Soil organisms in polluted soils, use of different organisms in decontamination of polluted soils, indicators of polluted soils. (allowance 2/1)11.Methods of study in soil biology. (allowance 2/1) a.Different tests of soil biological activity, their use and discussion on this topic.12.The role of microorganisms in the biosphere development. (allowance 2/1) a.Particular processes, the geological background.b.Life as a power in an evolution of the living world.c.Use of knowledges from soil biology.

en.content: The exam which is composed of oral and written forms. In written form, student is tested from knowledge based on the literature sources and has to approve minimally 60 % of required knowledge.
